verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Svelte as a compiler that turns components into lean, tightly optimized JavaScript that does minimal work in the browser. A community report of migrating a large React app cites a night-and-day bundle size improvement, which supports the small-bundle, low-runtime-footprint core of the story. Missing for 10: concrete bundle-size or runtime-size figures, and any evidence on dependency count or supply-chain risk reduction.
